name: fairfold-assets
description: Build-time asset pipeline for FairFold. No bundler, no SPA, and node_modules never reaches the runtime image.

scripts.check-budget: gzip -c static/css/tailwind.css | wc -c | awk '{ if ($1 >= 30720) { print "tailwind.css is " $1 " bytes gzipped, budget is 30720"; exit 1 } }'
